name: 80238 · Denver, CO
findings: ZIP 80238 (Denver) has 77 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80238 (Denver) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
